title: Prepare your environment
summary: Add friction and make your chosen actions easier.

friction.title: Reduce automatic access
friction.paragraph1: Leaving the phone outside the bedroom, setting time boundaries, or using the system focus mode can add intentional friction.
friction.paragraph2: A blocker can complement a plan, but it cannot resolve a difficulty on its own.

moments.title: Prepare vulnerable moments
moments.paragraph1: If tired evenings recur in your observations, preparing a simple routine or charging a device elsewhere can make the desired choice easier.
moments.paragraph2: If certain accounts or networks often come before difficult moments, you can adjust access without having to remove everything.

alternative.title: Make the alternative visible
alternative.paragraph1: Prepare an accessible replacement action: a book nearby, a short walk, or a task chosen in advance.
alternative.paragraph2: Your environment works best when it supports a specific intention.

reflectionPrompt: What change to your environment could you make today?
